title: Keto Smokehouse BBQ Board
seo_title: Keto BBQ Charcuterie Board: Smoked Meats & Cheese Plan
description: A keto smokehouse board for 8: smoked Gouda, pepper jack, aged cheddar, bacon, kielbasa, smoked beef sausage, pork rinds, pickles and pickled jalapeños.
hook: Smoked meats, smoked cheese and zero-carb crunch: a barbecue spread on a board.
why: Barbecue flavor without the sugary sauce: smoked Gouda, kielbasa and smoked beef sausage carry the smoke, and bacon and pepper jack add salt and heat.
Pork rinds are the zero-carb chip, and celery, pickles, pickled jalapeños and whole-grain mustard are the tangy sides that cut the fat. About 5 g net carbs per serving.

timeline.what: Take out the cheeses. Bake the bacon (400°F, about 18 min).
Slice and warm the kielbasa and smoked sausage in a skillet.
Cut the celery; fill the mustard and jalapeño bowls.
Add the warm sausages and pork rinds. Serve.

faq.a: Smoked meats are, but most barbecue sauces are high in sugar. Mustard, hot sauce and pickles keep the flavor without the carbs.
It can be served cool or warm. Sear sliced kielbasa for a minute a side if you want it warm.
About 5 g net carbs per serving for 8.
